evidence.claim: Case context shows in-person transaction 3602445 for $1,053.79 in region 315.0 with low calibrated model probability cms_p of 0.003849 on card C00750-K2.
Billing region 315.0 is known to card C00750-K2 with 200 prior transactions across 103 distinct days since 2016-07-02.
Card C00750-K2 prior transactions reflect a maximum in-person amount of $4,606.50, well above transaction 3602445 amount of $1,053.79.
Customer C00750 has 1 prior cleared case CC-0591 for travel/legitimate activity of the same alert template.
Customer C00750 has 16 prior confirmed fraud cases on card C00750-K2 between July and October 2016.
Assumed reply: customer confirmed travel to billing region 315.0 and recognises the $1,053.79 purchase

case.summary: The risk score alert on in-person transaction 3602445 ($1,053.79) for card C00750-K2 is evaluated as legitimate (probability 0.10, pattern none, exposure $0.00). Region 315.0 is well known to the card with 200 prior transactions, and the customer confirmed travel to region 315.0 and recognized the purchase. Under rule R3, the case is recommended for CLOSE_NO_FRAUD and ALLOW_TRANSACTION.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: ASSUMED (simulated): customer confirmed travel to billing region 315.0 and recognises the $1,053.79 purchase

initial.reason: 3a/§6: case opened to document the risk score alert review for card C00750-K2.
R1/§6: probability 0.10 < 0.70 on a single risk score alert requires verifying transaction 3602445 with the customer.

final.reason: 3a: case created to record the investigation and customer response for transaction 3602445.
R3: customer confirmed travel to billing region 315.0 and recognised the $1,053.79 purchase on transaction 3602445.
R3/§6: customer confirmed the transaction as legitimate and investigation confirms no fraud.

next_best_actions.what_changed: The assumed customer validation reply (confirm) left the probability at 0.10 and kept the verdict legitimate, adding ALLOW_TRANSACTION, CLOSE_NO_FRAUD, removing VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER. Counterfactual: had the customer denied the purchase, R2 would have applied: BLOCK_CARD (L1) and CREATE_CASE.

stop_reason: Policy §6 test 2: the customer confirmation settled the investigation. Probability 0.10 with 3 independent evidence families (customer, history, memory) also satisfies §6 test 1.
